Lions vs Vikings Betting History

Every Detroit Lions vs Minnesota Vikings game since the 1966 season: 119 meetings with the final score, the closing point spread, the closing total and how each game graded against both. The Vikings lead the series 80-38-1. Against the spread the Lions are 55-59-5 (Vikings 59-55-5), the over is 44-48-1, and the Vikings have outscored the Lions by 3.6 points a game.
